newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks close soft as labor strife grows.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks close soft as labor strife grows.

text.p: The Caracas bolsa closed off as investors shied away from Venezuelan stocks on growing signs of spreading labor unrest, traders said.
"The market was slow and flat. I'm sure its being affected by the worsening labor problems," Vencred broker Geronimo Paolini said.

The bolsa's leading 19-share index closed down 0.68 percent at 6,479.52 points as nearly 32 million shares traded worth 3.4 billion bolivars ($7.2 million), according to preliminary figures from the exchange.

A seven-day truce between the government and doctors is set to expire Wednesday night with as yet no sign of agreement on doctors' demands of a nearly 300 percent pay increase versus the government's 25 percent offer.
University professors are also set to begin an indefinite strike Wednesday over a 125 percent pay increase claim.

Among widely held stocks, steel manufacturer Sivensa SVSc.CR slipped 4.90 bolivars to end at 325.10, national telephone company CANTV edged ahead 1.50 bolivars to 1965.50, while foods company Mavesa closed up a hair gaining 0.25 bolivar to end at 40.00.
